This plot is small and intercropped, so I will manage it with what my household can afford and do by hand. I will save the chemical fertilizer and improved seed for my maize fields if I can get them, and on this plot I will mostly use local seed and some manure if I have enough. I do not plan to irrigate, and I will not buy pesticide because we rarely use it on food crops and money is tight. Most of the work will be done by my family, and I do not expect to hire much labor.
